verdict.rationale: v0 documents a Platform API that gives programmatic access to code generation, chat, project management and deployment. The official v0-sdk repo shows creating a chat from a prompt and authenticating with an API key, so apps can be both generated and managed programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage beyond first-party docs and SDK examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API

citations.quote: The v0 API gives you programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, letting you integrate v0's AI-powered code generation, chat interface, project management, and deployment features into your own applications and workflows.
Set V0_API_KEY, or deploy server-side code on Vercel with OIDC enabled, then use the default client.
